subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: COPPA and Children's Privacy
description: A quick win: understand COPPA and Children's Privacy.

hook.text: A law says companies can't collect data from kids under 13 without parental consent. Most ignore it.

buildup.text: COPPA, passed in 1998, was the first major law protecting children's data online.

discovery.text: YouTube paid $170 million in 2019 for illegally collecting data from children watching videos.

twist.text: Kids just enter a fake birthday. Age gates are security theater — and companies know it.

climax.text: COPPA exists, but enforcement is rare and penalties are pocket change for billion-dollar companies.

punchline.text: A law for kids. Barely enforced on giants.

quiz.question: What does COPPA require for collecting data from children under 13?
options: Children must pay for any data collected
Companies must delete data after 24 hours
